quests.title: A Morning Together
quests.summary: Mnki and Swan wake in the Sunshine Forest clearing. Time to head home to the treehouse.

objectives.text: Say good morning to your friend
Gather berries in the clearing
Open the Guardian Gate (south of the clearing)
Walk home to the treehouse

0: Swan: Good morning, sleepyhead! The forest smells like berries today.
Swan: Let's pick a few on the way home. The treehouse is past the Guardian Gate — follow the path south.

complete: Swan: Home! I'll never get tired of this door.
Swan: Thronn sent word — the animals miss us. Shall we visit the farm when you're ready?

quests.title: Gentle Hands
quests.summary: Thronn asked the duo to help with the animals at the farm (far south, past the colonies).

objectives.text: Visit Thronn at the Animal Farm
Gently pet an animal
Take feed from the bin and feed an animal

0: Thronn: There they are! No need to rush. Hold your hand low and let them come to you.
Thronn: Pet one first, then grab some Hay & Grain from the feed bin by the barn.

complete: Thronn: See? They already like you. Here — seeds from my garden. Bao can show you the plots.
Swan: The chicken bobbed its head at you! That's basically a hug.

quests.title: Open the Stall
quests.summary: Our little fruit stall in the Market Square has been quiet. Let's open it again.

objectives.text: Talk to Tamsin the grocer at the market
Sell goods worth 10 coins at our fruit stall

0: Tamsin: Your stall! I kept it dusted. Choose what to sell — you'll see every price before you confirm.
Tamsin: Berries are 2 coins, mangoes 5, fish fetch more. No pressure.

complete: Swan: Our first sale! We should put some coins back into the stall... or a rug. Maybe both, eventually.

quests.title: A Basket for the Village
quests.summary: The market feels sleepy. Mnki and Swan prepare a basket of fresh things for the neighbours.

objectives.text: Gather 3 berries (Berry Maze)
Gather 1 mango (Tropical Fruit Forest)
Care for an animal with Thronn
Prepare the basket at our fruit stall
Deliver the basket to Elder Maple in the park

offer: Swan: The market feels a little sleepy today. Shall we bring something fresh for the neighbours?

4: Elder Maple: A basket — for all of us? Oh, you two.
Elder Maple: Let's set it right here. Look at everyone gathering already.

complete: Elder Maple: The park hasn't felt this alive in a long while. Please, take this charm.
Swan: Look — they're planting the old flower bed again!

quests.title: Mend the Old Bridge
quests.summary: The old stream bridge between Colony Two and the Tropical Fruit Forest is broken. Odo sells timber planks.

objectives.text: Bring 4 timber planks to the broken bridge (Odo sells them)

offer: Elder Maple: The stream bridge east of Colony Two used to bring everyone together.
Elder Maple: Four good planks would mend it. Odo at the market sells them — whenever you have time.
complete: Swan: The bridge is back! Now the colonies and the orchard are neighbours again.

quests.title: Land, Water, Forest
quests.summary: Mira's clue says the three Guardian statues each hold a message. Read all three plaques, then tell the Elder.

objectives.text: Read the three Guardian plaques
Tell Elder Maple what the Guardians said

offer: Elder Maple: You've cared for land, water and the living things. Have you read what the Guardians say?

1: Mnki: The land asks to be tended, the water to be kept clear, the forest to be shared.
Elder Maple: Then you already understand. Tonight, the village celebrates — together.

complete: Swan: Lanterns in the park... for everyone. This is my favourite day.
Elder Maple: Keep this token. Land, Water, Forest — and friends.

quests.title: First Harvest
quests.summary: Bao will teach crop stages: plant, water each day, sleep, harvest.

objectives.text: Plant rice, water it each day and harvest it
Show Bao your rice

offer: Bao: Want to learn the plots? Plant rice, water it, sleep. A watered plot grows one stage each morning.
Bao: Here are a few seedlings to start.

1: Bao: Look at that bundle! You're a farmer now — a small one, but a farmer.

complete: Bao: Rice, greens, carrots, tomatoes, sunflowers — Tamsin sells all the seeds.

quests.title: Colours for the Garden
quests.summary: Rosa needs daisies to rebalance a flower bed.

objectives.text: Bring Rosa 4 Garden Daisies

offer: Rosa: That bed by the trellis is lopsided. Four daisies would balance it — gather them from the patches here or in the forest.
complete: Rosa: Perfect balance. Here, seeds for your own plots.

quests.title: Something Unusual
quests.summary: Ivo wants a Moonbell — a rare blue flower said to grow somewhere inside the Berry Maze.

objectives.text: Find a Moonbell (hidden in the Berry Maze) for Ivo

offer: Ivo: Rosa likes balance. I like surprises. Somewhere in the Berry Maze there's a Moonbell. Bring me one?
complete: Ivo: It glows! Take my paper lantern — it'll look lovely in your treehouse.

quests.title: Patience at the Pond
quests.summary: Lumi teaches the bite cue: wait, watch the bobber, press E when it dips.

objectives.text: Catch a fish at a fishing spot
Tell Lumi about your catch

offer: Lumi: ...Fishing? Stand on the bank and press E. When the bobber dips and splashes, press E again. That's all.

1: Lumi: A fine fish. You were patient.

complete: Lumi: Different water, different fish. The falls hide trout.

quests.title: The Lost Wind Chime
quests.summary: Pip lost a shell wind chime while picking fruit in the Tropical Fruit Forest.

objectives.text: Find Pip's wind chime in the Tropical Fruit Forest
Return the wind chime to Pip

offer: Pip: I lost my wind chime near the banana plants! It's small and it tinkles. Could you look?
complete: Pip: My chime! Listen — it's singing again. Please take this flowerpot from our garden!

quests.title: Pondside Picnic
quests.summary: Mira is planning a quiet picnic and needs a fish, a banana and a coconut.

objectives.text: Bring Mira 1 fish, 1 banana and 1 coconut

offer: Mira: I'm planning a picnic by the pond. One fish, one banana, one coconut — would you help?
complete: Mira: Wonderful. A secret for you: the Water Guardian is smiling. Read the plaques at the gate — all three.
Swan: A Guardian clue! Let's tell the Elder after we've read them.

quests.title: A Bigger Stall
quests.summary: Tamsin thinks the stall could use a second shelf and an order board.

objectives.text: Upgrade the fruit stall (Upgrade tab, 50 coins)

offer: Tamsin: A second shelf and an order board would let you take market orders. Fifty coins — whenever you're ready.
complete: Tamsin: Now that's a stall! Check the order board each morning.
